thoughts: The current masonry layout, while performing well in dwell time, lacks the 'architectural precision' that the headline suggests. By transitioning to a balanced 2x2 grid, we instill a sense of structural integrity and expert order. I have refined the typography to include a serif font for quotes to elevate the 'Expert' persona and utilized a cleaner, more clinical aesthetic with subtle borders and balanced spacing to align with the ergonomic wellness mission of Stitch. The imagery is now integrated into a horizontal card layout to maximize scanability and focus on the professional credentials of the endorsers.
